set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/stale-pidfile-startup
backup="$base/bin/control.pre-stale-pid-repair"
if [ ! -e "$backup" ]; then
  cp -p "$base/bin/control" "$backup"
  chmod 700 "$backup"
fi
tmp="$base/bin/.control.new.$$"
cat > "$tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_CONTROL_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
pidfile=$base/run/worker.pid
worker=$base/worker.py
lockdir=$base/run/control.lock
PID=
STATE=

get_pid()
{
    PID=$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
    case $PID in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) return 2 ;;
    esac
    [ "$PID" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null || return 2
    return 0
}

classify_pid()
{
    if get_pid; then
        :
    else
        rc=$?
        if [ "$rc" -eq 1 ]; then
            STATE=missing
        else
            STATE=stale
        fi
        return 0
    fi

    if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        STATE=stale
        return 0
    fi

    proc_state=$(ps -o stat= -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
    case $proc_state in
        ''|Z*) STATE=stale; return 0 ;;
    esac

    if [ ! -r "/proc/$PID/cmdline" ]; then
        STATE=foreign
        return 0
    fi
    arg0=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$PID/cmdline" | sed -n '1p')
    arg1=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$PID/cmdline" | sed -n '2p')
    case ${arg0##*/} in
        python|python[0-9]*) : ;;
        *) STATE=foreign; return 0 ;;
    esac
    if [ "$arg1" = "$worker" ]; then
        STATE=live
    else
        STATE=foreign
    fi
}

acquire_lock()
{
    if ! mkdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "control operation already in progress" >&2
        exit 75
    fi
    trap 'rmdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null || :' 0 1 2 15
}

start_worker()
{
    acquire_lock
    classify_pid
    case $STATE in
        live)
            echo "worker running (pid $PID)"
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            echo "removing stale pid file${PID:+ (pid $PID)}"
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            ;;
        foreign)
            echo "pid $PID belongs to another process; leaving it running"
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            ;;
        missing) : ;;
    esac

    nohup python "$worker" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    newpid=$!
    tmppid=$pidfile.tmp.$$
    if ! (umask 022; printf '%s\n' "$newpid" > "$tmppid"); then
        kill "$newpid" 2>/dev/null || :
        rm -f "$tmppid"
        echo "could not write pid file" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if ! mv -f "$tmppid" "$pidfile"; then
        kill "$newpid" 2>/dev/null || :
        rm -f "$tmppid"
        echo "could not install pid file" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    sleep 1
    classify_pid
    if [ "$STATE" != live ] || [ "$PID" != "$newpid" ]; then
        kill "$newpid" 2>/dev/null || :
        rm -f "$pidfile"
        echo "worker failed to start" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    echo "worker started (pid $PID)"
}

stop_worker()
{
    acquire_lock
    classify_pid
    case $STATE in
        live)
            kill "$PID"
            i=0
            while [ "$i" -lt 50 ]; do
                proc_state=$(ps -o stat= -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
                if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null || [ -z "$proc_state" ]; then
                    break
                fi
                case $proc_state in Z*) break ;; esac
                sleep 0.1
                i=$((i + 1))
            done
            proc_state=$(ps -o stat= -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
            if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null && [ -n "$proc_state" ]; then
                case $proc_state in
                    Z*) : ;;
                    *) echo "worker pid $PID did not stop" >&2; return 1 ;;
                esac
            fi
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            echo "worker stopped (pid $PID)"
            ;;
        stale)
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            echo "removed stale pid file${PID:+ (pid $PID)}"
            ;;
        foreign)
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            echo "pid $PID belongs to another process; left it running"
            ;;
        missing)
            echo "worker not running"
            ;;
    esac
}

status_worker()
{
    classify_pid
    case $STATE in
        live) echo "worker running (pid $PID)"; return 0 ;;
        stale) echo "stale pid file${PID:+ (pid $PID)}"; return 1 ;;
        foreign) echo "pid $PID belongs to another process"; return 2 ;;
        missing) echo "worker not running"; return 3 ;;
    esac
}

case ${1:-} in
    start) start_worker ;;
    stop) stop_worker ;;
    status) status_worker ;;
    *) echo "usage: $0 {start|stop|status}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
